title.en: See your IP, gateway and DNS server
title.hinglish: Apna IP, gateway aur DNS server dekho

why.en: These are the three things DHCP gave your laptop in step 1.
why.hinglish: Yeh teen cheezein DHCP ne step 1 mein tumhare laptop ko di thi.

expect.en: You see an IPv4 address, a default gateway and DNS servers. Values differ on every network; on macOS use ifconfig and netstat -rn instead.
expect.hinglish: Tumhe IPv4 address, default gateway aur DNS servers dikhenge. Har network par values alag hoti hain; macOS par ifconfig aur netstat -rn use karo.

why.en: Your laptop remembers the router's MAC address so it does not ask ARP every time.
why.hinglish: Laptop router ka MAC address yaad rakhta hai, isliye har baar ARP nahi poochta.

expect.en: A list of IP and MAC pairs; your gateway (for example 192.168.1.1) should be in it. The entries differ per machine.
expect.hinglish: IP aur MAC pairs ki list; tumhara gateway (jaise 192.168.1.1) usme hona chahiye. Entries har machine par alag hoti hain.

why.en: This is the same name-to-address lookup the browser does in step 3.
why.hinglish: Yeh wahi naam-se-address lookup hai jo browser step 3 mein karta hai.

expect.en: One or more IP addresses for example.com and the DNS server that answered. The dig output also shows the TTL; the address may differ from the lesson.
expect.hinglish: example.com ke ek ya zyada IP addresses aur jis DNS server ne jawab diya woh. dig output mein TTL bhi dikhta hai; address lesson se alag ho sakta hai.

title.en: Find the SYN packets in the capture

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap in Wireshark to see the TCP handshake.
why.hinglish: Downloaded .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur TCP handshake dekho.

expect.en: Two packets: the SYN from the laptop and the SYN-ACK from the server, to and from port 443.
expect.hinglish: Do packets: laptop ka SYN aur server ka SYN-ACK, port 443 ke saath.
